Deactivates ARS (Address Registry Screening) for the authenticated tenant (sets config.active to false). Once deactivated, ARS screening no longer applies until activated again.

**Returns:** [`*ArsConfigResponse`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otyang/fireblocks-go#ArsConfigResponse)

## SetByorkTimeouts

```go
func (s *ComplianceService) SetByorkTimeouts(ctx context.Context, body *ByorkSetTimeoutsRequest, opts ...RequestOption) (*ByorkConfigResponse, error)
```

`PUT /screening/byork/config/timeouts` · rate-limit category: `write`

**Set BYORK Light timeouts**

Updates timeout values for BYORK wait-for-response (incoming and/or outgoing). At least one of incomingTimeoutSeconds or outgoingTimeoutSeconds is required. Values must be within the ranges returned in GET config (timeoutRangeIncoming for incomingTimeoutSeconds, timeoutRangeOutgoing for outgoingTimeoutSeconds). Requires BYORK Light to be enabled for the tenant (contact your CSM to enable).

**Request body:** [`*ByorkSetTimeoutsRequest`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otyang/fireblocks-go#ByorkSetTimeoutsRequest)

**Returns:** [`*ByorkConfigResponse`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otyang/fireblocks-go#ByorkConfigResponse)

## GetByorkVerdict

```go
func (s *ComplianceService) GetByorkVerdict(ctx context.Context, txID string, opts ...RequestOption) (*GetByorkVerdictResponse, error)
```

`GET /screening/byork/verdict` · rate-limit category: `read`

**Get BYORK Light verdict**

Returns the current BYORK verdict and status for a transaction. Status can be PRE_ACCEPTED, PENDING, RECEIVED (verdict is final but processing not yet complete), or COMPLETED. Requires BYORK Light to be enabled for the tenant. Returns 404 if no BYORK verdict is found for the transaction.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `txID` | query | `string` | yes | Transaction ID |

**Returns:** [`*GetByorkVerdictResponse`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otyang/fireblocks-go#GetByorkVerdictResponse)

## SetByorkVerdict

```go
func (s *ComplianceService) SetByorkVerdict(ctx context.Context, body *ByorkVerdictRequest, opts ...RequestOption) (*ByorkVerdictResponse, error)
```

`POST /screening/byork/verdict` · rate-limit category: `write`

**Set BYORK Light verdict**

Submit verdict (ACCEPT or REJECT) for a transaction in the BYORK Light flow. If the transaction is awaiting your decision, the verdict is applied immediately (response status COMPLETED). If processing has not yet reached that point, the verdict is stored and applied when it does (response status PRE_ACCEPTED). Requires BYORK Light to be enabled for the tenant.

**Request body:** [`*ByorkVerdictRequest`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otyang/fireblocks-go#ByorkVerdictRequest)

**Returns:** [`*ByorkVerdictResponse`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otyang/fireblocks-go#ByorkVerdictResponse)


`POST /screening/transaction/{txId}/rescreen` · rate-limit category: `write`

**Rescreen a rejected transaction**

Re-runs compliance screening on an incoming transaction that was rejected or failed by screening checks, moving it back to pending screening. This endpoint is only applicable to incoming transactions with a rejected/failed AML screening status.

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `txID` | path | `string` | yes | The transaction id that was rejected by screening checks |

**Returns:** [`*RescreenTransactionResponse`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otyang/fireblocks-go#RescreenTransactionResponse)
